desc:
PEANUT FREE: These chewy granola bars are peanut free and made in a peanut free facility; Not all Nature Valley products are made in peanut-free facilities; Visit our website to learn more about this product

DOUBLE CHOCOLATE: Kids will love the irresistible taste of whole grain oats, milk chocolate, and chocolate chunks

WHOLESOME SNACKS: Parents can feel good about serving a wholesome snack

WHOLE GRAIN: Each serving provides 8g whole grain (At least 48g recommend daily) and is made with no artificial flavors, no artificial colors, and no high fructose corn syrup

CONTAINS: One 4.6 oz box of Nature Valley Double Chocolate Lunch Box Chewy Granola Bars
features:
Key Features:

Double Chocolate Flavor

Rich and chewy bars made with a blend of milk chocolate and chocolate chunks—perfect for chocolate lovers.

Peanut-Free

Made in a peanut-free facility, making them a safe snack option for those with nut allergies.

Whole Grain Goodness

Each bar includes 8g of whole grains to support a balanced diet.

No Artificial Additives

Free from artificial flavors, colors, and high-fructose corn syrup.

Lunchbox-Ready

Individually wrapped and kid-friendly, ideal for school snacks or on-the-go munching.

Benefits:

Great for Kids

Delicious chocolate taste and soft texture make it appealing to children.

Safe for Allergy-Conscious Families

Peanut-free production ensures added peace of mind for families with dietary concerns.
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Chicory Root Extract, Milk Chocolate (sugar, cocoa butter, chocolate liquor, milk ingredients, salt, soy lecithin, vanilla extract), Rice Flour, Chocolate Chunks (sugar, chocolate liquor, cocoa butter, soy lecithin, vanilla extract), Sugar, Corn Syrup, Vegetable Glycerin, Canola Oil, Maltodextrin, Soy Lecithin, Salt, Natural Flavor, Molasses, Baking Soda, Barley Malt Extract, Calcium Carbonate, Wheat Flakes.
